reviewer_role: independent narrow launch-boundary reviewer; no candidate authoring or grades
limitations: Initial reads were of live in-progress sources. Owners began repairing during review; observations describe initial inspected snippets, not a coherent approved frozen source set. No hashes approved.
No semantic candidate quality claim; machinery review does not count as a method comparison.

findings.claim: M/Z launch has no filesystem namespace boundary
findings.evidence: Initial run_attempt.py launches subprocess.Popen(cmd) where cmd is native/run_goal.py, with no namespace_command; native Host/Protocol launch installed binaries directly. Task text and read-only input modes do not hide evaluator/history files.

findings.claim: M/Z fixed whole clock excludes setup and RPC calls can overrun remaining wall cap
findings.evidence: Initial run_goal.py assigns t0 only after initialize/model/session/effort calls; Z sleeps and session/read(timeout45) occur before cap evaluation. Admission does not pass an absolute deadline.

findings.claim: Output freezing and slot release do not require sufficient quiescence evidence
findings.evidence: Initial freeze() records operator must independently establish but copies anyway. Initial slot_ledger.release() admits any truthy object. M/Z Host.close and Protocol.close stop their process without joined log writers or native inactive+idle evidence.

findings.claim: Source index omits numbered normative headings
findings.evidence: Initial source_index.py handles Markdown/HTML headings and code symbols only; numbered text such as 2. Scope and 2.1. Conditions has no locator.

findings.claim: Input admission lacks a source hash allowlist and rejects only leaf symlinks
findings.evidence: Initial copy_inputs() checks raw.is_symlink() only and does not consume an admitted_inputs path/hash allowlist; a symlinked parent bypasses this check.

findings.claim: L RPC.call timeout can be defeated by a continuous event stream
findings.evidence: Initial call() loops frames.get(timeout=max(.01,end-monotonic())) without checking end expiry; events continue indefinitely after deadline.

findings.claim: Aggregate occupied-slot admission does not reserve charged bounded cleanup
findings.evidence: Initial acquire commits research seconds only, although native cap shutdown performs additional waits. Cleanup counts in occupied-slot campaign ceiling.

findings.claim: L constructor failure after process start could be mistaken for server_not_started
findings.evidence: run() assigns rpc only after RPC constructor returns; finally uses server_not_started when rpc is None. Constructor owns opened files, Popen, reader startup without internal rollback.

requirements: freeze a coherent repair source set and provide hash manifest before re-review
at most two successive repair versions in this tranche
approve only exact source/dependency hashes after deterministic offline checks
retain all original defects and unusable attempts
